findings.evidence: LatticeDefect/Basic.lean:105-108 `/-- Equivalent representations have equal reduction classes. -/ theorem reductionK0_congr … (e : ρ.Equiv σ) : reductionK0 k ρ = reductionK0 k σ`; Lattice.lean:111-112 hypothesis is `Nonempty ((Representation.baseChange ℚ …).Equiv (Representation.baseChange ℚ …))`. Naming guide: hypotheses are described after `of` precisely to "better convey the intended reference".
findings.fix: Put the base change in the names, e.g. `reductionK0_eq_of_nonempty_equiv_baseChange_rat` and `reductionK0_eq_of_nonempty_equiv_baseChange_rat_of_charP`, and update the module docstring references at lines 26, 42-44.
findings.issue: `reductionK0_eq_of_nonempty_equiv` (and `reductionK0_eq_of_nonempty_equiv_of_charP`, line 108) name the hypothesis as a plain `Nonempty (ρ.Equiv σ)`, but the hypothesis is an equivalence of the base changes to ℚ. As named, both read as the `Nonempty`-wrapped form of the existing `reductionK0_congr {ρ σ} (e : ρ.Equiv σ) : reductionK0 k ρ = reductionK0 k σ`, i.e. a far weaker and already-proved statement; users will mistake which hypothesis is required.

findings.evidence: TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/Lattice.lean:66-71 `theorem _root_.Representation.Equiv.exists_intertwiningMap_comp_eq_smul … : ∃ … (∀ v, f' (f v) = (s : R) • v) ∧ …` — same condition, named `comp_eq_smul`.
findings.fix: Rename to carry `comp`, e.g. `Representation.IntertwiningMap.baseChange_apply_baseChange_apply_of_comp_eq_smul`, and update the single use site (LatticeDefect/Lattice.lean:172).
findings.issue: `baseChange_baseChange_apply_of_apply_eq_smul` names the hypothesis `∀ v, g (f v) = r • v` as `apply_eq_smul`, dropping `comp`; that reads as a single map's value being a scalar multiple. The repo already names this exact condition `comp_eq_smul`, so the two names for one condition diverge.

summary: Both new main theorems are named `…_of_nonempty_equiv`, which denotes an equivalence of V and W — the hypothesis of the already-landed `reductionK0_congr` — whereas they only assume an equivalence of the ℚ-rationalizations; the name must say so. The new BaseChange lemma also renames the `comp_eq_smul` condition already established in the repo to `apply_eq_smul`.
